风格参考图/风格图鉴_15种风格_01逐帧手绘_012s.jpg
items.visual: 火苗角色从火柴盒上活动，轮廓不规整、边缘保留手绘笔触，随后转成手作字牌；整体是纸面插画而非矢量图形。
items.motion: 离散姿态逐帧切换，每个动作只有少量关键姿势，不做中间插值；轮廓用少量变体切换表现犹豫与尝试。
items.lighting: 平光为主，靠纸张固有色与笔触阴影暗示体积，不追求真实光比；高光靠留白而非渐变。
items.texture: 纸张纹理贯穿全画面，边缘有轻微毛边与颗粒，数字与条件部分保持锐利干净。
items.use: 手作、生活观察、人物感受、温暖或略笨拙的体验；不完全规整的轮廓能形成更亲近的表达。
items.migration: 用离散姿态、少量轮廓变体和固定纸纹表现犹豫、尝试；不是给精密比例图加随机抖动。
items.limitations: 真正手绘仍需素材制作，SVG 轮廓变体或序列图只能承担近似效果。
items.mix: 与扁平、线条动画易共享轮廓与配色；不宜与高细节 3D 渲染直接混搭。
items.prompt:
【画面】火苗角色从火柴盒上活动，轮廓不规整、边缘保留手绘笔触，随后转成手作字牌；整体是纸面插画而非矢量图形。
【配色】#484334、#e7dcb4（自参考图实际提取）
【动法】离散姿态逐帧切换，每个动作只有少量关键姿势，不做中间插值；轮廓用少量变体切换表现犹豫与尝试。
【光影】平光为主，靠纸张固有色与笔触阴影暗示体积，不追求真实光比；高光靠留白而非渐变。
【质感】纸张纹理贯穿全画面，边缘有轻微毛边与颗粒，数字与条件部分保持锐利干净。
【适用】手作、生活观察、人物感受、温暖或略笨拙的体验；不完全规整的轮廓能形成更亲近的表达。
【限制】真正手绘仍需素材制作，SVG 轮廓变体或序列图只能承担近似效果。
【混搭边界】与扁平、线条动画易共享轮廓与配色；不宜与高细节 3D 渲染直接混搭。

风格参考图/风格图鉴_15种风格_02等轴2.5D_023s.jpg
items.visual: 网格地块上逐步出现建筑，砖块、设备、管线层层堆叠成完整城市与数据牌；斜视等轴视角全程不变。
items.motion: 地块与建筑沿等轴轴向逐格生长，物体按深度分层排序进出，不做透视旋转。
items.lighting: 顶面亮、侧面中调、底面暗的三段式块面明暗，模拟单一顶光，不使用连续渐变。
items.texture: 表面平整，块面干净，靠面与面的色差区分体块，无写实材质贴图。
items.use: 需要同时看清部件位置及系统运作：工厂、物流、供水、芯片模块；固定斜视能保留空间关系。
items.migration: 工厂中让原料沿输送带进入设备，成品从出口出现。
items.limitations: 简单场景可 SVG 投影／图层排序，复杂场景再用正交 3D；不能以玩具城市冒充真实地理、尺度或产能数据。
items.mix: 与扁平条件标签易共享配色；插入二维段落时需保持同一对象与颜色含义。
items.prompt:
【画面】网格地块上逐步出现建筑，砖块、设备、管线层层堆叠成完整城市与数据牌；斜视等轴视角全程不变。
【配色】#43424b、#d0c9e1、#696874（自参考图实际提取）
【动法】地块与建筑沿等轴轴向逐格生长，物体按深度分层排序进出，不做透视旋转。
【光影】顶面亮、侧面中调、底面暗的三段式块面明暗，模拟单一顶光，不使用连续渐变。
【质感】表面平整，块面干净，靠面与面的色差区分体块，无写实材质贴图。
【适用】需要同时看清部件位置及系统运作：工厂、物流、供水、芯片模块；固定斜视能保留空间关系。
【限制】简单场景可 SVG 投影／图层排序，复杂场景再用正交 3D；不能以玩具城市冒充真实地理、尺度或产能数据。
【混搭边界】与扁平条件标签易共享配色；插入二维段落时需保持同一对象与颜色含义。

items.visual: 明亮城市图形铺满画面，随后出现「进步」「搞定」「心动」等几何图标分区，抽去材质后关系优先于质感。
items.motion: 形状与色块位移淡入淡出，缓动平滑；图标按分区依次出现，不用弹跳。
items.lighting: 无真实光照，全部为平涂色块，靠面积对比而非明暗建立层级。
items.texture: 纯色填充，无渐变无阴影无噪点，留白充足。
items.use: 比较、分类、比例、因果与日常知识；抽去材质后关系更容易突出。
items.migration: 可乐比例、两组条件、同一对象前后状态，是现有 flat-motion 的优先方向。
items.limitations: 避免把整片退化为图标配字幕的幻灯片。
items.mix: 与线条动画、局部形变通常容易共享轮廓和配色。

【配色】#2c2742、#2a1cf7、#eee7d3（自参考图实际提取）

【光影】无真实光照，全部为平涂色块，靠面积对比而非明暗建立层级。
【质感】纯色填充，无渐变无阴影无噪点，留白充足。
【适用】比较、分类、比例、因果与日常知识；抽去材质后关系更容易突出。
【限制】避免把整片退化为图标配字幕的幻灯片。
【混搭边界】与线条动画、局部形变通常容易共享轮廓和配色。

items.visual: 细线先描出植物轮廓，之后延展为建筑与远景；画面主体是一条持续生长的路径。
items.motion: SVG 路径按描边进度生长，线条分叉时用端点标记引导视线；线宽在小屏需加大。
items.lighting: 无光照概念，线条明度层次靠线的粗细与叠加密度表达。
items.texture: 极简，只有线条与必要标签，背景大量留白。
items.use: 路径、连接、成长、连续时间或推理线索；一条持续的线能引导视线并保留来路。
items.migration: 适合人物轨迹、液体流经路径、供应链。
items.limitations: 细线在手机端易丢失，分支太多会失去追踪目标，必要标签应就近出现。
items.mix: 与扁平矢量共享配色；与贴纸、拼贴混搭需统一信息层级。

items.name: 3D 渲染
items.status: 本地已有（学习沉淀，尚未全部实现为风格包）
items.sourcePath: <私有工程>/15种风格学习与使用契机.md
refs: 风格参考图/风格图鉴_15种风格_053D渲染_052s.jpg
风格参考图/风格图鉴_15种风格_053D渲染_057s.jpg
items.visual: 有体积的 soft 字母与球阵表面接触，材质与光照明确可见，二维平面无法承担的接触与受力关系被立体呈现。
items.motion: 物体做刚体位移、旋转与挤压，接触面随形变连续变化；不是简单调缓动。
items.lighting: 真实三光源：主光定方向、辅光定反差、轮廓光分离主体；材质反射与次表面散射可见。
items.texture: PBR 材质，有粗糙度、金属度与反射环境；表面细节是真实渲染结果。
items.use: 材料触感、剖面、接触、挤压、层次或真实立体结构；侧面和受力变化能承担二维难讲的关系。
items.migration: 可用于包装剖面、装置工作过程；可预渲染后放入 Remotion，或按需求用 3D 场景。
items.limitations: 逼真外观不代表物理模型正确；不默认全片升级 3D。
items.mix: 3D 剖面插入二维片时，保持同一对象、颜色含义和变化方向。
items.prompt:
【画面】有体积的 soft 字母与球阵表面接触，材质与光照明确可见，二维平面无法承担的接触与受力关系被立体呈现。
【配色】#4d3e3f、#efcfc6、#c8a8af（自参考图实际提取）
【动法】物体做刚体位移、旋转与挤压，接触面随形变连续变化；不是简单调缓动。
【光影】真实三光源：主光定方向、辅光定反差、轮廓光分离主体；材质反射与次表面散射可见。
【质感】PBR 材质，有粗糙度、金属度与反射环境；表面细节是真实渲染结果。
【适用】材料触感、剖面、接触、挤压、层次或真实立体结构；侧面和受力变化能承担二维难讲的关系。
【限制】逼真外观不代表物理模型正确；不默认全片升级 3D。
【混搭边界】3D 剖面插入二维片时，保持同一对象、颜色含义和变化方向。

items.visual: 同一中心区域先后呈现太阳、爱心等轮廓，形态在相关概念之间连续转接。
items.motion: SVG 路径插值，形状在保持锚点的前提下连续变化；拓扑不匹配时改为遮罩或分段变化。
items.lighting: 跟随母版风格，若母版为平涂则形变过程中不加独立光照。
items.texture: 继承母版纹理，变形时纹理不随之拉伸变形。
items.use: 相关概念之间的连续转接、同一对象的抽象归纳；让观众看到「从什么到什么」。
items.migration: 可从杯子轮廓转成比较容器，或将一组对象整理成比例图。
items.limitations: 科学片不能让无关物质互变，或以形变暗示不存在的反应。
items.mix: 与扁平、线条易共享轮廓和配色。
items.prompt:

【动法】SVG 路径插值，形状在保持锚点的前提下连续变化；拓扑不匹配时改为遮罩或分段变化。
【光影】跟随母版风格，若母版为平涂则形变过程中不加独立光照。
【质感】继承母版纹理，变形时纹理不随之拉伸变形。
【适用】相关概念之间的连续转接、同一对象的抽象归纳；让观众看到「从什么到什么」。
【限制】科学片不能让无关物质互变，或以形变暗示不存在的反应。
【混搭边界】与扁平、线条易共享轮廓和配色。

items.sourcePath: <私有工程>/15种风格学习与使用契机.md
refs: 风格参考图/风格图鉴_15种风格_08赛博朋克HUD_085s.jpg
风格参考图/风格图鉴_15种风格_08赛博朋克HUD_089s.jpg
items.visual: 球形扫描界面转成橙色目标锁定状态，周围密集排布读数、弧线与刻度。
items.motion: 扫描线绕轴旋转，锁定时环收缩并闪变目标色，读数按固定刷新节奏跳动。
items.lighting: 发光自照明界面，辉光由加色叠加产生，背景压暗；物体本身靠边缘光分离。
items.texture: 细线、噪点、扫描线、等宽字体，界面元素半透明叠加。
items.use: 观众需要跟随「检测—筛选—定位」的过程，或主题本就涉及传感器、雷达、网络。
items.migration: 把信号检测的一个有效指标做成主线，其余装饰克制。
items.limitations: 禁用无依据的精密读数；医学、研究结果不靠仪表感增加可信度。SVG/Canvas 可实现多数面板，不因 HUD 外观默认需要 WebGL。
items.mix: 与扁平易共享配色；不宜整片使用，否则会抢走科普主体的可读性。
items.prompt:
【画面】球形扫描界面转成橙色目标锁定状态，周围密集排布读数、弧线与刻度。
【配色】#061312、#274343、#9da1a0、#757a79、#c6cac8（自参考图实际提取）
【动法】扫描线绕轴旋转，锁定时环收缩并闪变目标色，读数按固定刷新节奏跳动。
【光影】发光自照明界面，辉光由加色叠加产生，背景压暗；物体本身靠边缘光分离。
【质感】细线、噪点、扫描线、等宽字体，界面元素半透明叠加。

items.visual: 蓝色分层天空与暖橙太阳、浅奶油云构成背景，两侧甘蔗／玉米、深绿层叠地貌与岩石平台建立纵深，中央是红罐与棕色冰杯两个主体对象；黑色轮廓、颗粒与抖色形成老游戏观感。
items.paletteDesc: 天空深 #124389、天空中 #1662be、天空亮 #3c92dd、日落橙 #ef8938、纸色黄 #ffcc53、奶油高光 #ffedb2、深蓝轮廓 #171421、植被深 #163d3e、植被中 #264e35、植被亮 #6f9f34、红罐亮 #e83a2c、红罐暗 #9b202b、可乐黑 #1f1415、可乐棕 #321a16、琥珀高光 #965025、葡萄糖 #ffcd60、果糖 #ec869c
items.motion: 整数运动坐标与整像素平移，阶梯轮廓，稀疏抖色；太阳为逐行像素圆盘，远景／云／植物／主体分层运动；场景接力用 18 帧短空间过渡，背景从不卸载。
items.lighting: 深蓝轮廓压边、奶油色高光提亮、暖光阴影过渡，三段式像素质感，不做连续渐变。
items.texture: 颗粒与稀疏抖色，无摄影材质；基本逻辑像素 4px，480×270 逻辑画布输出 1920×1080（V4.9 继承 640×360 逻辑画布，输出 1280×720 或 1920×1080 按整数倍放大）。
items.use: 已有 EP001 可乐系列的主风格；适合规则化、层级清晰的程序化 2D 动画。
items.migration: Sprite 可用整数或少量统一比例缩放；大型关键对象采用固定比例，避免不断缩放导致边缘闪烁。数字比例宽度保留小数，不为像素取整破坏定量含义。
items.limitations: 为可编辑的 2D 程序像素动画，纹理与美术密度比参考图简化；不声称达到参考图手工插画精细程度。
items.mix: 换画幅时重排文字与对象，不能仅拉伸；文字主次、条件共同窗口和视觉焦点需按实际设备再验。
items.prompt:
【画面】蓝色分层天空与暖橙太阳、浅奶油云构成背景，两侧甘蔗／玉米、深绿层叠地貌与岩石平台建立纵深，中央是红罐与棕色冰杯两个主体对象；黑色轮廓、颗粒与抖色形成老游戏观感。
【配色】天空深 #124389、天空中 #1662be、天空亮 #3c92dd、日落橙 #ef8938、纸色黄 #ffcc53、奶油高光 #ffedb2、深蓝轮廓 #171421、植被深 #163d3e、植被中 #264e35、植被亮 #6f9f34、红罐亮 #e83a2c、红罐暗 #9b202b、可乐黑 #1f1415、可乐棕 #321a16、琥珀高光 #965025、葡萄糖 #ffcd60、果糖 #ec869c（风格包固定色板）
【动法】整数运动坐标与整像素平移，阶梯轮廓，稀疏抖色；太阳为逐行像素圆盘，远景／云／植物／主体分层运动；场景接力用 18 帧短空间过渡，背景从不卸载。
【光影】深蓝轮廓压边、奶油色高光提亮、暖光阴影过渡，三段式像素质感，不做连续渐变。
【质感】颗粒与稀疏抖色，无摄影材质；基本逻辑像素 4px，480×270 逻辑画布输出 1920×1080（V4.9 继承 640×360 逻辑画布，输出 1280×720 或 1920×1080 按整数倍放大）。
【字体】微软雅黑高清层，主标题约 72–76px，主要标签 44–64px，边界说明 32–40px，深色描边；实际字库由运行环境提供，不打包系统字体。
【镜头语言】红罐作为入口与微观段落的连续主体，原料对象向糖符号运动；双糖／游离单糖进入整杯比较；杯子延续到研究与饮用条件；罐体进入压力与剖面；最终返回双杯。
【适用】已有 EP001 可乐系列的主风格；适合规则化、层级清晰的程序化 2D 动画。
【限制】为可编辑的 2D 程序像素动画，纹理与美术密度比参考图简化；不声称达到参考图手工插画精细程度。
【混搭边界】换画幅时重排文字与对象，不能仅拉伸；文字主次、条件共同窗口和视觉焦点需按实际设备再验。

items.motion: 固定机位，动效全部来自图形自身：描线生长、匀速平移、逐格点亮、辉光呼吸。文字入场只用五种——直接出现、缩放弹出、淡入、逐字出现、滑入；退场只用直接消失、缩小消失与淡出。缩放弹出走 0.86→1.0 的回弹曲线，位移一律匀速。整体节奏慢，一镜平均 15 秒左右。
items.lighting: 每场景一个径向柔光（紫 #33294b，中心偏移，半径占画面高 0.08–0.30），外加极细亮线的外发光（blur 24px、opacity 0.55）。没有方向光、没有硬阴影、没有轮廓光；层次靠底色明度差（#010003–#0a0517）与图形本身的低饱和紫灰阶拉开。
items.texture: 画面完全干净：无颗粒、无噪点、无纸张或扫描纹理，边缘锐利无编码糊边。所有颜色低饱和，整片只有一种高饱和色——青柠绿，用作答案与正确项的标记。
items.use: 知识科普型解说片、成长曲线与平台期这类抽象概念的数据可视化短片；需要冷峻理性但不冰冷、能把概念画成仪表盘感的场合。
items.migration: 用描边矢量图形代替插画与实拍，用位置+尺寸+颜色的有限编码代替复杂美术；靠字号分层与等宽小标建立信息秩序，不是靠画面细节。
items.limitations: 色板为 56 个场景逐帧取色后的语义归并值，ratio 是各色在设计系统内的相对权重（底色按自产参考板实测占画面 91%）；本风格不含实拍质感、不含体积光与粒子系统，做不出真实场景的摄影感。
items.mix: 可与数据图表、代码渲染的信息图混搭，可套进任何需要「冷静展示一张图」的解说框架；不宜与手绘、赛博朋克霓虹、写实三维渲染直接混搭（饱和度与边缘处理冲突）。
items.prompt:
【画面】暗紫近黑纯色底 + 径向柔光 + 极细描边矢量图形的演播室式版面。画面主体是 2–6px 的细线图形：圆角方块阶梯、五线谱与圆点音符、霓虹管电视机、远/近轴线、记分牌、交叉折线图；文字是衬线中文主标题压等宽英文小标，像仪表面板上的刻度标签叠在图形上。全片无实拍、无照片、无三维模型、无人物。
【配色】底色 #080412、背景光 #33294b、白字 #e9e4f6、中性白 #c7c4cf、灰字 #a19cb6、蓝字 #8679a5、青柠绿 #b2c783、粉字 #efb4d3（风格包固定色板）
【动法】固定机位，动效全部来自图形自身：描线生长、匀速平移、逐格点亮、辉光呼吸。文字入场只用五种——直接出现、缩放弹出、淡入、逐字出现、滑入；退场只用直接消失、缩小消失与淡出。缩放弹出走 0.86→1.0 的回弹曲线，位移一律匀速。整体节奏慢，一镜平均 15 秒左右。
【光影】每场景一个径向柔光（紫 #33294b，中心偏移，半径占画面高 0.08–0.30），外加极细亮线的外发光（blur 24px、opacity 0.55）。没有方向光、没有硬阴影、没有轮廓光；层次靠底色明度差（#010003–#0a0517）与图形本身的低饱和紫灰阶拉开。
【质感】画面完全干净：无颗粒、无噪点、无纸张或扫描纹理，边缘锐利无编码糊边。所有颜色低饱和，整片只有一种高饱和色——青柠绿，用作答案与正确项的标记。
【字体】中文衬线（思源宋体 / Noto Serif CJK SC）承担标题与正文；英文等宽（JetBrains Mono，字距 0.14）承担小标与章节牌。中文换成无衬线会立刻变成 PPT 模板感。
【镜头语言】全部固定机位，无推拉摇移；运动来自图形自身位移与背景光漂移。景别靠元素尺寸与留白控制：主标题占画面宽 30–50%，图形区居中偏下，上方三分之一留给标题。
【适用】知识科普型解说片、成长曲线与平台期这类抽象概念的数据可视化短片；需要冷峻理性但不冰冷、能把概念画成仪表盘感的场合。
【限制】色板为 56 个场景逐帧取色后的语义归并值，ratio 是各色在设计系统内的相对权重（底色按自产参考板实测占画面 91%）；本风格不含实拍质感、不含体积光与粒子系统，做不出真实场景的摄影感。
【混搭边界】可与数据图表、代码渲染的信息图混搭，可套进任何需要「冷静展示一张图」的解说框架；不宜与手绘、赛博朋克霓虹、写实三维渲染直接混搭（饱和度与边缘处理冲突）。

items.visual: A black and white dot pattern merges from a distance into apparent shades of gray and soft gradients. Limited colors are spatially distributed to approximate intermediate tones. Error diffusion passes rounding errors to neighboring pixels.
items.motion: Older algorithms. Personal computer look with MacPaint from 1984 onwards.
items.lighting: 依赖原始光照与拍摄条件，本身不引入光源。
items.texture: Bill Atkinson's MacPaint for the Macintosh (1984) shaped monochrome computer graphics.
items.use: 特点：black and white dot pattern；approximate intermediate tones；Error diffusion passes rounding errors
items.migration: Older algorithms. Personal computer look with MacPaint from 1984 onwards.
items.limitations: Pixelation reduces the resolution; dithering distributes a limited number of colors for tonal simulation. Both can be combined. Do not confuse this with the invention of the halftone screen in printing and photography. This refers to digital tonal simulation with a limited number of colors.
items.letzaiPrompt: Apply a 1-bit dithering effect using only pure black and pure white pixels. Translate shadows and gradients into tightly distributed error-diffusion dot patterns, with denser black clusters in darker regions, crisp pixel-stepped edges, and no actual gray, color, blur, or transparency. Keep the original subject and composition.

items.visual: Surface patterns stretch and skew as the camera moves, producing wobbly textures on walls and floors. Nearby polygon edges may show vertex jitter, a separate but often accompanying artifact. Affine texture mapping interpolates texture coordinates across screen-space triangles without perspective correction, distorting patterns on surfaces that recede into depth. Vertex jitter instead comes from limited coordinate precision, including snapping projected vertices to whole-pixel positions.

【配色】#12151a、#d2d2d1、#78787d、#484750、#a7a7a8
【动法】印刷与抖动类效果，用网点或阈值分布模拟印刷质感。
【光影】网点与阈值会把连续明暗压成硬边色块。
【参考图】Atkinson Dither, applied to “Coffee, notebooks and pen (Unsplash)”
【效果指令】Apply an Atkinson Dither effect using pure black and white pixels, with compact dot clusters, open white highlights, and bold dark shadow areas. Replace smooth shading with airy, high-contrast pixel patterns that retain less midtone detail, avoiding gray pixels and regular checkerboard screens. Keep the original subject and composition.
【素材出处】Image: Samantha Scholl sauriel · CC0 (via Wikimedia Commons), processed for the Atlas

items.visual: A dense repeating pattern covers a flat picture, often resembling colorful wallpaper or visual noise. With the right gaze, a hidden three-dimensional shape appears within it. Small changes in horizontal spacing encode depth within the pattern. When your eyes match different repetitions, binocular disparity makes the brain interpret those differences as depth.

items.migration: 1990s popularization; English-language Magic Eye book, 1993
items.limitations: A conventional stereogram presents separate left-eye and right-eye pictures. An autostereogram combines the necessary depth cues in one patterned image, without colored filters or a stereoscope.

Keep the original subject and composition.

items.visual: Sculpted cheekbones, luminous skin, and a butterfly-shaped shadow beneath the nose define a common version of this look. Bright hair highlights and deep backgrounds often accompany a soft glow around facial highlights. A key light placed above the camera and aimed downward creates the central nose shadow; separate lights can outline the hair. Optical diffusion spreads bright light into neighboring image areas, while negative retouching can smooth skin without changing the lighting pattern.

【效果指令】Apply Hollywood Glamour Lighting with luminous monochrome skin tones, sculpted contours, and a high frontal key light producing a butterfly-shaped nose shadow where applicable. items.visual: Faces become landscapes, architecture becomes organisms. New intermediate forms continuously change their meaning. A model generates images along interpolated latent representations or parameters. Learned image structures replace simple pixel blending.

items.migration: GAN history. Open diffusion experiments, especially from 2022/2023 onwards.
items.limitations: Frame interpolation fills in temporal intermediate frames of a movement. Generative image interpolation can switch between different image content. Not every AI zoom is a true latent morph. Latent interpolation predates the 2020s. In that decade, with the widespread use of image generators, it became a highly visible creative practice.

items.limitations: Unlike hand-drawn psychedelic art, a Mandelbrot image contains strict mathematical self-similarity. Zooming into a normal drawing reveals blurry pixels, not infinitely sharp new structures.

items.visual: Real cities look like toys. A narrow strip of focus separates the blurred foreground from the background. Selective focus imitates miniature images. Elevated viewpoints, vibrant colors, and time-lapse photography can enhance the impression of size.
items.motion: Late 2000s: Miniature look on the web. Optical precursors were older.
items.lighting: 依赖原始光照与拍摄条件，本身不引入光源。

items.use: 特点：Real cities look like toys；A narrow strip of focus；Selective focus imitates miniature images
items.migration: Late 2000s: Miniature look on the web. Optical precursors were older.
items.limitations: A true miniature is physically constructed. Miniature faking alters the perceived size of a real scene. Shift alone, for example, straightens building perspectives. Tilt and shift are different lens movements. For the miniature look, the precise focus plane is crucial; digitally, the look can be achieved entirely without a special lens.
items.letzaiPrompt: Apply a miniature faking effect with a narrow, sharply focused band across the main subject and progressively stronger blur toward the foreground and background. Increase color vibrancy, tidy fine textures, and introduce gently toy-like surface clarity and bright model-display lighting without changing the viewpoint. Keep the original subject and composition.

items.visual: You see black-and-white photographs with distorted, fluid, or torn areas. The darkest parts often look like floating veils or wrinkled skin. Keep the original subject and composition.

items.visual: You see a series of sequential drawings arranged in a circle on a flat disc. When viewed properly, these drawings merge into an endlessly repeating moving image. Narrow radial slits block your vision while the disc spins, revealing each drawing only for a split second. This rapid replacement creates the illusion of continuous motion through persistence of vision.

items.visual: Moving figures dissolve into flowing motion trails, overlapping contours, and translucent smears against a relatively still background. Sharper resting positions sometimes anchor the blurred movement. During a long exposure, light from a moving subject reaches successive areas of the photographic surface. Continuous recording creates connected traces rather than isolated snapshots; the trails form during exposure, not development.

items.visual: Transparent plastic shows rainbow fringes against a dark background when viewed between crossed polarisers. Curved bands crowd around holes, corners, and loaded contact points. Stress-induced birefringence makes two perpendicular polarisation components travel at different speeds through the material. A second polariser lets these components interfere, producing coloured bands in white light.

items.migration: 1930s engineering use; established in the nineteenth century
items.limitations: Unlike diffraction rainbows, these colours arise from stress-dependent birefringence, not light spreading around edges or through fine grooves. They are not pigments within the plastic.

items.visual: You see a photographic image with continuous tones, incredibly rich, velvety blacks, and subtle grays. Under magnification, the image is made of a random, microscopic grain pattern rather than regular dots. Light exposure hardens a gelatin layer on a copper plate, dictating how deeply acid bites into the metal. Ink settles into these varying etched depths, transferring continuous tones to paper under heavy pressure.

items.migration: 1879, Karl Klietsch's perfected process
items.limitations: Unlike standard halftone prints, which use grids of tiny dots to fake grays, photogravure varies physical depth. This results in true continuous tones rather than an optical illusion.

Keep the original subject and composition.

items.visual: Melting lettering fills tightly packed shapes, often making words look like pictures. Vibrating complementary colours surround swirling ornaments, distorted figures, and dense decorative borders. Strong hue contrast with similar lightness can make neighbouring colours seem to shimmer along their edges. This perceptual effect involves simultaneous contrast; printed inks absorb selected wavelengths rather than emitting coloured light.

items.visual: With one eye darkened, sideways motion appears to curve through depth. A swinging pendulum seems to follow an elliptical path instead of moving within one plane. Reduced brightness creates a processing delay in the darkened eye's visual pathway. During lateral motion, this timing difference produces binocular disparity, which the brain interprets as depth.

items.visual: Controls resemble physical objects, with raised buttons, simulated materials, and familiar details such as stitching or ruled paper. Leather, wood grain, and green felt can turn screens into desks, shelves, or gaming tables. Digital textures, gradients, and shadows simulate surface materials and depth on a flat display. These visual metaphors connect software functions with familiar objects, without requiring their physical construction.

items.limitations: Realistic shading alone is not necessarily skeuomorphism: the design must borrow recognizable features from another object or material. Flat design generally reduces texture and depth, though it can retain object-based metaphors.

items.visual: A heatmap uses color to show match strength at each tested position, revealing likely matches for a chosen image patch. The algorithm slides a template across the image and compares pixel values at each position. It converts these comparisons into similarity scores, then maps the scores to colors.

items.use: 特点：match strength；compares pixel values；similarity scores
items.letzaiPrompt: Apply Template Matching Heatmap using a distinctive existing image patch as the reference. Overlay translucent blue for weak similarity, yellow for moderate matches, and red hotspots at strong matching positions. Retain visible photographic structure beneath the smooth score field, without inventing repeated objects. Keep the original subject and composition.

items.visual: You see a single composite image that flickers slightly. It is formed by visually blending two separate pictures located on opposite sides of a spinning disc. Rapid rotation causes the viewer's eyes to retain the image of each side for a fraction of a second. This biological quirk fuses the two alternating views into one combined scene.
items.motion: 1825, popularized by John Ayrton Paris
items.lighting: 依赖原始光照与拍摄条件，本身不引入光源。
items.texture: John Ayrton Paris: A bird and a cage thaumatrope, 1825.
items.use: 特点：single composite image；visually blending two separate pictures；fuses the two alternating views
items.migration: 1825, popularized by John Ayrton Paris
items.limitations: Unlike a zoetrope, which creates the illusion of continuous motion from sequential frames, a thaumatrope only merges two static images.
items.letzaiPrompt: Apply a Thaumatrope effect, rendering the scene as two optically blended illustrations on warm ivory card. Use faint doubled contours, translucent overlapping layers, subtle rotational smearing, and alternating pale and dark edge echoes to suggest a flickering spinning disc frozen mid-turn. Keep the original subject and composition.

items.promptRaw:
Please use "Line art" (ラインアート), one of the names in "Art styles for image generation".
Motion Prompt #208

What it is: Drawn only with lines in one color, no fill
What the sample shows: The same line drawing becomes a detailed drawing in one dark navy pen on cream paper, with every roof tile, leaf, blade of grass and sun ray drawn in line.
Spec:
- Medium: one dark navy pen on cream paper
- Look: fine lines only, with every detail drawn in; the line weight varies
- Avoid: fills and shaded areas
- Sample: the same base sketch (a line drawing of a house, a tree and the sun on a hill) was given to an image model as a reference and redrawn in this style. A diagonal wipe turns the sketch into the style from 0.5 s to 1.35 s, the picture slowly zooms to 1.045x until 4.0 s, and it fades back to the sketch from 4.0 s to 4.5 s (one pass = 4.7 s, cubic ease-in-out)
When to use it: For coloring pages, field guides or packaging where the beauty of the line should show.

Reference implementation (Canvas 2D, a function whose picture depends only on the time): https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/en/e/208.txt
